description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” compares the performance of two models — LLaMA-3-8B-it (represented by dark blue bars) and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” (represented by orange-brown bars) — across nine different datasets and evaluation metrics, which are listed along the horizontal axis: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, indicating the percentage score achieved on each benchmark. For most benchmarks, “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” achieves scores equal to or higher than LLaMA-3-8B-it, with notable exceptions such as GSM-8K and MMLU where LLaMA-3-8B-it slightly leads. The highest scores are observed on GSM-8K, where both models exceed 75%, and the lowest scores appear on Chat-Arena-Hard, where both models score below 30%. The chart visually emphasizes the comparative performance across diverse tasks, including mathematical reasoning (GSM-8K), general knowledge (MMLU), code generation (HumanEval, MBPP), truthfulness (TruthfulQA), and conversational quality (MT-Bench, Chat-Arena-Hard), suggesting that the Iterative RLHF approach yields competitive or superior results across a broad set of academic and practical benchmarks.
